thread:
sarah_sales: FYI — LatticeOps just dropped an RFI. They want a capability appendix + POC pricing scenarios by EOD Thursday. Main asks: on-prem HSM compatibility, SLA & p95 numbers, throughput for 256/1024 context, and a sample eval dataset. Any immediate blockers?

aj_martinez: I can own the capability appendix. Quick q: do we want to surface q4 vs q8 quantization perf explicitly for their T4 fleet? @mike_eng can you confirm numbers?

mike_eng: Yep. Quick numbers off perf lab: 13B q8 on T4 ~45-60 qps/GPU at 256 avg tokens; 70B q4 on A10/T4 class ~6-8 qps. P50 latencies ~80ms vs ~220ms. p95 depends a lot on batching; I'll add P95 samples for 256/1024. Streaming supported, but tail latency increases with concurrent prefix cache misses.

olivia_security: For HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via CloudKMS and HSM integrations. For on-prem air-gapped we have an HSM shim workflow but need the customer's vendor/model list to confirm. I'll draft the security questionnaire responses and flag anything requiring legal. Need to know which region they want SOC2 evidence from.

sarah_sales: Good. Pricing note from RFP: they asked for a 4-week POC (3 GPUs) and an option to convert to Dedicated. @ben_support any guidance on POC discounts + committed tiers?

ben_support: Standard approach: 50% off usage for the first month for POCs + waive onboarding if they commit >= $50k ARR within 60d. For Dedicated we offer 10–15% for 12mo commits; 18–22% for multi-year strategic deals. I'll draft three scenarios: POC-only, POC->Dedicated ramp (3mo), POC->Annual commit.

aj_martinez: I'm assembling the matrix now. Columns: feature | hosted | dedicated | private | notes. Example CSV snippet I'll drop into the appendix:

```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private,notes
streaming,yes,yes,yes,continuous batching + streaming hooks
kv-cache,yes,yes,partial,private requires extra config and storage mount
hsm,no,yes,yes,BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private; hosted offers CMEK (cloud KMS)
quantization,q8/q4,q8/q4,q8/q4,performance varies by model & hardware
slas,standard-pro,enterprise,SLA-negotiable,enterprise SLA available on Dedicated/Private
```

olivia_security: Also uploading the security answers doc. Internal link: s3://redwood-shared/latticeops/rfi/security_answers_v1.pdf (will move to secured share). Ask the customer for their IP allowlist and expected token ingest rate so we can size logging retention and egress controls.

sarah_sales: Can we also include a short perf attachment showing p50/p95 for 256 and 1024 contexts for the two model classes? That was a direct ask. @mike_eng @aj_martinez please add config and test commands so procurement can reproduce.

mike_eng: Will add the perf table + the repro commands. Example test command I'll include: `./perf_client --model red-13b-q8 --context 256 --batch 8 --duration 300`. Expect to push final p95 numbers and notes by Wed EOD.

aj_martinez: Uploading attachments now: LatticeOps_Capabilities_appendix_v1.csv, LatticeOps_POC_PricingScenarios_v1.xlsx, LatticeOps_SecurityAnswers_v1.pdf. Public preview links (internal): https://redwood.docs/attachments/1908451234/capabilities.csv , https://redwood.docs/attachments/1908451234/pricing.xlsx , https://redwood.docs/attachments/1908451234/sec_answers.pdf

sarah_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks all — I'll review the docs and send a consolidated packet to LatticeOps procurement/legal after Mike's p95s land. If anything blocks the HSM confirmation, @olivia_security flag it early so we don't miss their deadline.

ben_support: Noted. I'll include the commercial term suggestions in the pricing sheet and mark negotiable fields.

aj_martinez: One last note for the appendix: call out regression guardrails (eval prompt set) — we'll attach a short prompt pack and sample outputs so they can validate quality on their data.

sarah_sales: Perfect. Sending calendar invite for sync tomorrow 10am to finalize.
